summary: Ellington Credit Company filed an 8-K to report a routine monthly common dividend declaration of $0.08 per share, payable June 30, 2026, to holders of record May 29, 2026. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is present. The filing merely announces a standard dividend and provides a press release. There are no deal terms, premium, or strategic changes involved. This is a routine current report not constituting a special situation.
